title: Applied: rectangle from its perimeter and area

section.book: Bittinger, Beecher, Ellenbogen & Penna, College Algebra: Graphs and Models, 7e
section.title: Quadratic Equations, Functions, Zeros, and Models

process_card: Bittinger's five steps for applied problems

problem.prompt: A rectangle has perimeter {P} ft and area {A} ft^2. Find its dimensions.

steps.name: familiarize
steps.show: Let x = the length; then the width is {s} - x (half the perimeter minus x).

steps.name: state
steps.show: The rectangle is {L} ft by {W} ft.

answer.say: The dimensions are {L} ft by {W} ft.

mistakes.name: used the whole perimeter as length + width
mistakes.message: Length + width is half the perimeter, because P = 2l + 2w.

mistakes.name: gave one dimension
mistakes.message: State both dimensions: length and width.

hints.hint: Name the length x and write the width in terms of x.

hints.why: The area gives the equation; the perimeter gave the width.

hints.hint: Expand, get 0 on one side, factor.
Do the two numbers give the perimeter and the area?
Answer in a sentence with units.
hints.why: The question asked for dimensions, not x.
